# UPPAbaby Mesa V3 (US)

- **Id:** `uppababy-mesa-v3`
- **Category:** car-seat
- **Status:** shortlisted
- **Price:** $349.99
- **Brand:** UPPAbaby
- **Maker's page:** <https://uppababy.com/car-seats/infant/mesa-v3/james/>
- **Decision:** [ADR 0004: Buy the UPPAbaby Aria V2 infant car seat](../../decisions/0004-buy-the-uppababy-aria-v2.md)

## Summary

Fits the same UPPAbaby strollers as the Aria V2, with a 32 in height limit and three ways to install without the base ([V3 manual](https://back.prod.uppababy.com/media/eb/4b/cc/1767623777/US-EN_1003-MSA_MesaV3Manual_251226.pdf)). Its base has no load leg ([market survey](../../research/notes/2026-11-27-infant-car-seat-market-survey.md)), and [BabyGearLab](https://www.babygearlab.com/reviews/vehicle-safety/infant-car-seat/uppababy-mesa-v3) found its LATCH install not the most stable in the group. The carrier weighs about 10.9 lb (measured). [NHTSA](https://api.nhtsa.gov/childSeats?dataSet=ratings&max=100&offset=0) rated the older V2 5 stars for ease of use; the V3 is not rated.

## Safety

- **Standards:** FMVSS 213, FMVSS 213a
- **FMVSS 213a (decision 0001):** recorded
- **Recall search last run:** 2026-11-27
- **Recalls:** none found in the search of 2026-11-27

## Pros

- Baseless European-routing install "remarkably stable compared to competitors", no towel ([BabyGearLab V3](https://www.babygearlab.com/reviews/vehicle-safety/infant-car-seat/uppababy-mesa-v3)).
- Three baseless methods allowed (European, optional lap/shoulder, lap-only), so it has a fallback in taxis ([V3 manual](https://back.prod.uppababy.com/media/eb/4b/cc/1767623777/US-EN_1003-MSA_MesaV3Manual_251226.pdf)).
- 32 in height limit, longer than the Aria V2 and KeyFit 30 ([manual](https://back.prod.uppababy.com/media/eb/4b/cc/1767623777/US-EN_1003-MSA_MesaV3Manual_251226.pdf)).
- [NHTSA ease-of-use](https://api.nhtsa.gov/childSeats?dataSet=ratings&max=100&offset=0) rated the Mesa V2 5 stars in every category; V3 not rated (older version).
- Canopy "one of the best in the group" and never hits the handle ([BabyGearLab V3](https://www.babygearlab.com/reviews/vehicle-safety/infant-car-seat/uppababy-mesa-v3)).
- No-rethread harness with 25 headrest positions ([maker](https://uppababy.com/car-seats/infant/mesa-v3/james/)).

## Cons

Misuse risks come first.

- **Misuse risk:** a CPST saw the base's tightness indicator show green while the base was "still way too loose" ([The Car Seat Lady](https://thecarseatlady.com/icsbg-uppababy/), original Mesa base; same base family, not retested on V3). Always do the manual's 1-inch movement test.
- **Misuse risk:** two owners report the base indicator going from green back to red while driving ([Babylist](https://www.babylist.com/gp/uppababy-mesa-v3/74913/2528374), 2026-09-29), the same symptom Aria V2 owners report. Low confidence.
- **Misuse risk:** the lock-off does little to hold the base on a vehicle belt; it "rocked fairly easily" under force ([BabyGearLab V3](https://www.babygearlab.com/reviews/vehicle-safety/infant-car-seat/uppababy-mesa-v3)). LATCH install avoids this.
- Several owners report a newborn's head falling chin to chest; one baby failed a car seat test with the newborn insert and passed without it ([Babylist owner reviews](https://www.babylist.com/gp/uppababy-mesa-v3/74913/2528374)). Low confidence.
- Consumer Reports has not tested V3; the Mesa V2 scored 68 (24th of 46) and is not CR Recommended ([read through Nick's CR account](https://www.consumerreports.org/babies-kids/car-seats/uppababy-mesa-v2/m408511/)).
- Carrier measured 10.9 lb on V3, against the maker's 9.9 lb ([BabyGearLab](https://www.babygearlab.com/reviews/vehicle-safety/infant-car-seat/uppababy-mesa-v3)).
- Buckle is stiff to press; the latch plates must be pulled out ([BabyGearLab V3](https://www.babygearlab.com/reviews/vehicle-safety/infant-car-seat/uppababy-mesa-v3)).
- Manual mixes a "bubble" instruction with its green/red level marker ([V2](https://back.uppababy.com/media/d9/9b/d9/1745851419/1002-MESAV2-ProductManual_240509_US.pdf?ts=1745851419) and [V3](https://back.prod.uppababy.com/media/eb/4b/cc/1767623777/US-EN_1003-MSA_MesaV3Manual_251226.pdf) manuals).
- Stroller range is UPPAbaby strollers plus Mockingbird adapters; not on Thule's chart ([market survey](../../research/notes/2026-11-27-infant-car-seat-market-survey.md)).

## Notes

- Fallback under [ADR 0004](../../decisions/0004-buy-the-uppababy-aria-v2.md) if the Aria V2 fails the Model Y test install.
- Expiry depends on the manual revision printed for the unit: 7 years ([rev. 250529](https://back.prod.uppababy.com/media/a7/fb/b5/1752587108/1003-MSA-US_MesaV3Manual-EN_250529.pdf)) or 10 years ([rev. 251226](https://back.prod.uppababy.com/media/eb/4b/cc/1767623777/US-EN_1003-MSA_MesaV3Manual_251226.pdf)); check the label.
- BabyGearLab's [2023 V2 test](https://www.babygearlab.com/reviews/vehicle-safety/infant-car-seat/uppababy-mesa-v2) found the level indicator narrow and hard to read; its [2026 V3 test](https://www.babygearlab.com/reviews/vehicle-safety/infant-car-seat/uppababy-mesa-v3) found it forgiving.
- No CPST hands-on review of V3 daily use exists ([mesa-v3 usability note](../../research/notes/2026-11-27-uppababy-mesa-v3-usability.md)).
- Recall check is a text search of [NHTSA's flat file](https://static.nhtsa.gov/odi/ffdd/rcl/FLAT_RCL_POST_2010.zip).
- Unknown: Model Y recline without a towel ([mesa-v3 usability note](../../research/notes/2026-11-27-uppababy-mesa-v3-usability.md)).
- Unknown: fit at 4 and 7 months ([mesa-v3 usability note](../../research/notes/2026-11-27-uppababy-mesa-v3-usability.md)).
- Unknown: durability ([mesa-v3 usability note](../../research/notes/2026-11-27-uppababy-mesa-v3-usability.md)).
- Unknown: carrier height on a stroller, open question 28 ([mesa-v3 usability note](../../research/notes/2026-11-27-uppababy-mesa-v3-usability.md)).
- Unknown: base width ([market survey](../../research/notes/2026-11-27-infant-car-seat-market-survey.md)).
- Price seen during Black Friday 2026 ([market survey](../../research/notes/2026-11-27-infant-car-seat-market-survey.md)).
